name: Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon
short_description: The Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon is a full marathon held in Chiang Mai, Thailand on December 20, 2026, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon is a full marathon event taking place on December 20, 2026 in Chiang Mai, Thailand. Organized by Jog & Joy Co., Ltd. and presented by Muang Thai, the race starts at Tha Phae Gate and finishes at the King Naresuan the Great Monument in Mae Rim. Runners can choose from four distances: 42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km, and 3 km. Registration is currently open, with entry priced at THB 1500.

faqs.question: When is the Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 20, 2026. The event is held in Chiang Mai, Thailand, and registration for the race is currently open for runners interested in participating in any of the available distances.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distance options to accommodate different runners: a full marathon of 42.195 km, a half marathon of 21.1 km, a 10 km race, and a shorter 3 km run, allowing participants of varying experience levels to take part.

faqs.question: Where does the race start and finish?
faqs.answer: The Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon begins at the historic Tha Phae Gate in Chiang Mai and finishes at the King Naresuan the Great Monument located in Mae Rim, giving runners a route that connects two notable landmarks in the region.

faqs.question: How much does it cost to register for the race?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon is priced at THB 1500. Registration is currently open, so interested runners can sign up for one of the four available distances, including the marathon, half marathon, 10 km, or 3 km race.
